Hey Yokes Master Plumbing team,

I looked at your website and noticed two things: every "MORE" button on your homepage just opens your contact page, so no single service has its own page, and your site never shows a street address, only "Wichita, KS and surrounding area". Your Google reviews are strong, so the site should show off your work the way your customers do.

We build websites for service businesses. If you'd like, we'll make you a free mockup of your homepage that fixes both. Want me to send you one?

Josh, Fluid Frame Marketing

P.S. On one of our websites, this message never would have reached you. We filter out solicitations, including ours.
